Mr. William S. Luhman Assistant Director: Implementation Northeastern Illinois Planning Comms. 10 South Riverside Plaza Chicago, Illinois 60606
Dear Mr. Luhman:
Subject: Funding for Improvement to
FAP Route #23 Lincoln Highway from
Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road
Ti A C C C C C C C C C C C C C C C C C C
Thank you for the opportunity to comment on the above-cited project. We are already on record as favoring the proposed improvement as it affects Chicago Heights between Western Avenue and Chicago Road. The improvement should reduce traffic hazards, increase traffic flow, and improve the appearance of the highway.
This project is already behind schedule. We were promised that land acquisition for the improvement would begin in 1973. The present surface of Highway 30 is deteriorating rapidly and cannot take any more delays. We urge prompt approval and funding of this improvement.
Very truly yours,
GEORGE R. BONICK
Mayor
